_help.colors.primary: Main brand colour — heading band, cover title, links
_help.colors.secondary: Subtitle, table header row, h3 headings
_help.colors.light: Banded table rows, inline-code background, blockquote background
_help.fonts: CSS font stacks; the first family is also used for DOCX
_help.logo: Path to an SVG/PNG/JPG (relative to this file). SVG/PNG/JPG embed in HTML/PDF; only PNG/JPG embed in DOCX.
_help.generate: Run extract_theme.py against a .pptx/.potx to fill this in from a real brand template.
